n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 510
factorial = [0] * maxn
inv_factorial = [0] * maxn
inv = [0] * maxn

def precompute():
    factorial[0] = factorial[1] = inv[1] = inv_factorial[0] = inv_factorial[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, maxn):
        factorial[i] = (factorial[i-1] * i) % mod
        inv[i] = mod - ( (mod // i) * inv[mod % i] ) % mod
        inv_factorial[i] = (inv_factorial[i-1] * inv[i]) % mod

def choose(a, b):
    return (factorial[a] * (inv_factorial[b] * inv_factorial[a - b] % mod)) % mod

def sum_pairs(x):
    return x * (x + 1) // 2

precompute()

f = [0] * maxn
c = [0] * maxn
dpA = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
dpB = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

f[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        f[i] += (choose(i - 1, j) * f[j] * f[i - 1 - j]) % mod
        if f[i] >= mod:
            f[i] -= mod
        c[i] += ( (i + 1) * choose(i - 1, j) * (sum_pairs(j) + sum_pairs(i - 1 - j)) * f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] ) % mod
        c[i] %= mod
    f[i] = (f[i] * (i + 1)) % mod

dpA[0][0] = 1
for k in range(1, n + 1):
    dpA[k][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, min(m, k) + 1):
        dpA[k][i] = dpA[k - 1][i]
        dpB[k][i] = dpB[k - 1][i]
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            valA = (f[j] * dpA[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            valA = (valA * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dpA[k][i] = (dpA[k][i] + valA) % mod

            valB1 = (c[j] * dpA[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            valB1 = (valB1 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dpB[k][i] = (dpB[k][i] + valB1) % mod

            valB2 = (f[j] * dpB[max(k - j - 1, 0)][i - j]) % mod
            valB2 = (valB2 * choose(i, j)) % mod
            dpB[k][i] = (dpB[k][i] + valB2) % mod

print(dpB[n][m])
